translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Zaburi mar Daudi. Lemo mar kwayo kony.

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ikwera ka in gi mirima
bende kik ikuma ka mirima mager omaki.
Nikech aserni magi osechwoya,
kendo lweti osebet kuoma.
Mirimbi mager osemiyo ringra obedo maonge ngima maber;
chokena ok winj maber nikech richona.
Ketho ma asekethogo oima
mana ka lodi mapek mohinga tingʼo.
Adhondena otimo tutu kendo dungʼ marach
nikech fupa mar timo richo.
Adolora kendo akulora piny chuth odiechiengʼ duto,
awuotho koni gi koni, ka akuyo.
Ondingʼa rama gi rem malich;
ringra onge gi ngima maber.
Denda ool kendo tekra orumo chuth;
achur nikech chunya lit.
Gik ma chunya dwaro duto ongʼereni maber, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
chur ma achurgo ok opondoni.
Chunya gwecho, tekra orumo;
wengena otimo mudho.
Osiepena gi anywolana ok dwar nena nikech adhondena;
joma odak buta otangʼ koda.
Joma dwaro kawo ngimana ochiko obadhogi,
joma dwaro hinya chano kaka ginyalo tieka chuth.
Gichano miriambo odiechiengʼ duto.
Achalo ngʼama ite odino, ma ok nyal winjo wach,
mana ka momo ma ok nyal yawo dhoge;
Achalo gi ngʼat ma ok winj wach,
ma dhoge ok nyal dwoko wach.
To in ema ariti, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo angʼeyo ni ibiro dwoka, yaye Ruoth Nyasacha.
Nimar ne awacho niya, “Kik iyie mondo gisungrena,
kata gigona siboi ni tienda okier.”
Nimar achiegni podho,
kendo rem ma an-go osiko koda.
Ahulo kethona;
richona chando chunya.
Wasika molwora ngʼeny;
joma ochaya maonge gima omiyo thoth mokalo akwana.
Joma chulo rach kuom ber ma asetimonegi
kuodho nyinga ka an to alawo gima ber.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ijwangʼa;
kik ibed mabor koda, yaye Nyasacha.
Bi piyo mondo ikonya,
yaye Ruoth Nyasaye kendo Jawarna.
